name: Yuunaga Yuna
source:
Born in 2008. First year at Keisei.
When she was young, she experienced sexual harassment, and she has suffered from androphobia ever since. She now has a secret crush on her her senior schoolmate, and she falls asleep admirably looking at pictures of her secretly taken after school.
